name: LayerNorm
description: LayerNorm over the last dimension with affine weight and bias, eps=1e-5. Compute statistics in float32; inputs and output are float16.
signature: run(x: Tensor[M, N], weight: Tensor[N], bias: Tensor[N]) -> Tensor[M, N]
